description: Utility functions for rendering and formatting NVD3-based charts in Superset, including tooltip generation, label formatting, and domain calculations.

methods.name: cleanColorInput
methods.description: Sanitizes and filters color input strings, removing right axis labels and time shift patterns.

methods.name: getTimeOrNumberFormatter
methods.description: Returns a formatter function based on whether the format is a smart date or a number format.

methods.name: drawBarValues
methods.description: Draws labels on bar chart SVG elements, positioning them based on bar dimensions and stacking.

methods.name: generateCompareTooltipContent
methods.description: Creates HTML content for comparison tooltips, showing series data sorted by value.

methods.name: generateMultiLineTooltipContent
methods.description: Creates HTML content for multi-line chart tooltips, including series labels and values.

methods.name: generateTimePivotTooltip
methods.description: Creates HTML content for time pivot tooltips, highlighting series with 'current' key.

methods.name: generateBubbleTooltipContent
methods.description: Generates HTML for bubble chart tooltips, showing point details.

methods.name: hideTooltips
methods.description: Hides or removes all tooltips from the DOM.

methods.name: generateTooltipClassName
methods.description: Generates a CSS class name for tooltips based on UUID.

methods.name: removeTooltip
methods.description: Removes a specific tooltip element identified by UUID.

methods.name: wrapTooltip
methods.description: Wraps chart tooltip content generator to include custom HTML.

methods.name: tipFactory
methods.description: Creates a D3 tooltip with specified class, position, and content based on data.

methods.name: getMaxLabelSize
methods.description: Calculates maximum label size for axes in SVG.

methods.name: formatLabel
methods.description: Formats axis labels, replacing time shift patterns with verbose labels.

methods.name: stringifyTimeRange
methods.description: Converts a time range extent to ISO string format, joined by colon.

methods.name: setAxisShowMaxMin
methods.description: Sets the display of max/min labels on an axis.

methods.name: computeYDomain
methods.description: Calculates Y axis domain based on data, considering only enabled series.
